units.source_text: 后面二楼的天花板很高。

en.t: The ceiling on the second floor at the back was very high.

units.source_text: 有两间六叠大的房子，是父母和千重子的起居室和寝室。

en.t: There were two rooms about six tatami mats in size, serving as the living room and bedroom for her parents and Chieko.

units.source_text: 千重子坐在镜前，松开发束。

en.t: Chieko sat before the mirror and loosened her tied-up hair.

units.source_text: 头发长长的，梳理得很美。

en.t: Her hair was long and beautifully combed.
